description: VIT Bhopal University to Host Health Hackathon 3.0 in January 2027 The event invites innovative ideas to improve healthcare access and reduce costs. VIT Bhopal University will host Health Hackathon 3.0 on 28 and 29 January 2027, with a pre-event workshop scheduled for 27 January 2027. The event is being organised in collaboration with the Whiting School of Engineering at Johns Hopkins University. Its full title is “Health Hackathon 3.0: Global Health Access Innovation Challenge – Next Generation.” New Ideas for Better Healthcare The hackathon aims to encourage innovative ideas that improve healthcare accessibility, reduce costs, and enhance overall efficiency. Participants are invited to propose actionable solutions to real-world healthcare challenges. Key focus areas include: Low-cost tools and technologies for healthcare delivery New platforms and approaches to support mental health. Applications of Artificial Intelligence (AI) in healthcare. Tools that use health data analytics to identify and predict health risks. A Chance to Share and Develop Ideas Health Hackathon 3.0 invites innovators, students, and researchers to present and refine their concepts. The focus is on practical, high-impact solutions that can reach underserved communities and individuals facing barriers to healthcare access. Event Overview and Key Dates Pre-Event Workshop: 27 January 2027 Main Hackathon: 28–29 January 2027 Venue: VIT Bhopal University, Bhopal, Madhya Pradesh Registration and Submission Registration is now open. Interested teams and individuals must submit their project proposals.

raw.details:
VIT Bhopal University to Host Health Hackathon 3.0 in January 2027

The event invites innovative ideas to improve healthcare access and reduce costs.

VIT Bhopal University will host Health Hackathon 3.0 on 28 and 29 January 2027, with a pre-event workshop scheduled for 27 January 2027.

The event is being organised in collaboration with the Whiting School of Engineering at Johns Hopkins University. Its full title is “Health Hackathon 3.0: Global Health Access Innovation Challenge – Next Generation.”

New Ideas for Better Healthcare

The hackathon aims to encourage innovative ideas that improve healthcare accessibility, reduce costs, and enhance overall efficiency. Participants are invited to propose actionable solutions to real-world healthcare challenges.

Key focus areas include:

 

  • Low-cost tools and technologies for healthcare delivery
  • New platforms and approaches to support mental health.
  • Applications of Artificial Intelligence (AI) in healthcare.
  • Tools that use health data analytics to identify and predict health risks.

 

A Chance to Share and Develop Ideas

Health Hackathon 3.0 invites innovators, students, and researchers to present and refine their concepts. The focus is on practical, high-impact solutions that can reach underserved communities and individuals facing barriers to healthcare access.

Event Overview and Key Dates

  •  

    Pre-Event Workshop: 27 January 2027
  • Main Hackathon: 28–29 January 2027
  • Venue: VIT Bhopal University, Bhopal, Madhya Pradesh
Registration and Submission

Registration is now open. Interested teams and individuals must submit their project proposals.
